ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent payment escrow system built on BSV for instant, micro-fee autonomous service settlements between agents.
ideas.title: BSV Agent Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the BSV Blockchain sponsor track with low-fee instant transaction infrastructure tailored for agentic payments.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized data marketplace where AI agents autonomously purchase paywalled APIs and datasets using micro-transactions on-chain.
ideas.title: Agentic Data Broker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the 'Agentic Payments' core theme of the hackathon while leveraging BSV high-throughput capabilities.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge authentication system allowing autonomous agents to prove identity and budget authorization without revealing private keys.
ideas.title: ZK-Gated Agent Auth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering in ZK cryptography with agentic security, matching patterns from winning ZK-focused hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized network where AI agents autonomously bid on and pay for distributed GPU compute tasks using instant blockchain transactions.
ideas.title: Autonomous Compute Swarm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses real infrastructure needs for scaling autonomous AI agents and targets the main sponsor track.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered risk scoring agent that monitors autonomous on-chain agent transaction streams for illicit behavior and flags them instantly.
ideas.title: Agentic AML Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Blends graph intelligence and risk detection frameworks similar to past hackathon winners with blockchain transaction feeds.
